arms.spacing_provenance: User measured 52.65 inches; base-to-base interpretation assumed

board.mount_status: provisional rigid fixed joint; compliance is NOT calibrated or modeled yet

bucket.height_interpretation: unresolved: overall height or interior depth

dropper.tool_status: geometric two-finger proxy; not a calibrated gripper model

camera.status: synthetic ideal fixed RGB-D; not wrist-camera calibration

simulation.contact_properties_status: uncalibrated; separate from historical numerical models

parent.release: ball center Z = board center H + ball radius + gap; fixed XY
parent.plane: Y=-0.10 m; normal toward bucket along -Y; board and release centers share X/Y
parent.selection: top three captures by reward, deterministic ID tie break; five fresh repeats each
parent.scope: development grid search, no RL training, no generalization test; endpoint initialization, not path validation

parent_quality.refinement: top12 captures by quality/margin: gap +/-10mm, tilt +/-1.5deg; deduplicate
parent_quality.confirmation: six geometrically separated finalists; each20 nominal +20 independently seeded bounded H/G/tilt perturbations; frozen selection before confirmation

quality.2: capture with no observed bucket force >0.01N before first entry or near rim, no subsequent partial exit, and >=1mm mouth clearance
quality.1: capture with bucket contact or marginal/unknown entry clearance

parent_quality.capture: existing board bounce + whole ball entry + continuous1second retention
parent_quality.scope: fixed400mm distance; development search, not RL; ideal repeated simulation is not physical reliability

contract.supports: table/floor are stationary kinematic rigid bodies for supported GPU contact filtering; geometry unchanged; rechecked controls
contract.selection: up to two board-only captures by single-bounce/tier/reward; 10 screening perturbations each; freeze best by captures/single-bounce/clean/id; 30 fresh seeds, no retuning
contract.scope: development search, not RL or held-out generalization; fixed board XY, bucket-facing heading; endpoint initialization; no robot path validation
contract.route_definition: historical board-bounce/whole-ball/1s capture plus one or more board contact episodes (single-bounce captures counted separately) and no detected table/floor/robot/other contact during flight; bucket rim allowed
contract.sensor_limits: 240Hz normal contact force threshold; aggregate simultaneous forces may cancel; subthreshold contacts not certified absent
